title: Finnish Labour Temple
geometryBasis: OSM historical way 88723774 version 4 supplies the mapped orientation and prefire footprint. Lakehead accession MG8_D11Ai1 independently shows massing, street alignment and the entrance silhouette.
sectionBasis: Dated Lakehead archive prints provide the tapered cupola tower, front bay heights, front doorway and stair proportions. National designation describes the joined hipped sections and symmetrical façade.
limitations: This is the early 1910 exterior. The original hall burned in December 2021 and its remains were cleared in 2022.
Rear elevation and roof transitions use the prefire outline with interpreted openings. Early masonry color, minor details and heights are estimated from archival prints.
